media.title: Jesse Greer and Raymond Klages — MGM advertisement, 1929
media.altText: Songwriters Jesse Greer and Raymond Klages posed at a piano in a 1929 advertisement.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. The Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer advertisement was published in the United States in 1929, so its U.S. copyright term has expired. No individual photographer is credited, and the applicable term for an anonymous work published more than seventy years ago has also expired in the European Union.
